title: Merge K Sorted Arrays
prompt: Given `k` sorted integer arrays (e.g. partial results returned from `k` shards of a distributed search or a sharded inference batch), merge them into a single sorted array.
constraints: The total number of elements across all arrays is at most 10^5
hints: Merging all k arrays pairwise, one at a time, is O(kn) in the worst case — a min-heap gets you to O(n log k).
Push the first element of each array onto a heap, tagged with which array (and index) it came from.
Pop the minimum, append it to the result, and if that array has a next element, push it onto the heap.
